title: System and design questions, at the level they are actually asked

videos.script: Some interviews include a question like: how would you build this? Or: how would you set up the network for this office? {{q}} Juniors dread it, because the words sound like something for seniors. At junior level the question is much smaller than it sounds. {{smaller}} Nobody expects you to design for a million users. They expect you to ask how many users there are, draw the simplest thing that works, and say where it would break first. {{expect}} This lesson gives the answer four stages, shows the level these questions are really asked at, and deals with the moment the interviewer pushes past what you know.
